description: Literature review map in one call. Give a seed paper (DOI, arXiv id, OpenAlex id, or PMID) or a topic query and get one structured result: the seed's references, its cited-by list (most-cited first), and semantically related work, deduplicated into one uniform table with title, authors, year, venue, DOI, and citation count. Collapses search, citation lookup, and related-paper discovery into a single call. Keyless. [$0.08/call]. Params — q: topic query (seed = top hit); use this OR id/doi; id: seed paper: arXiv id, DOI, OpenAlex id, or PMID; doi: alias for id (DOI form); maxItems: max nodes per section (1-25) Example params: {'doi': '10.48550/arXiv.1706.03762', 'maxItems': 10}
name: lit_review
